checks.detail: 20/20 files match size, SHA256 and MD5; full manifest checked before and after independent tests. V2 changes exactly nine age_group cells from blank to adult; all other TSV fields and IDs unchanged from reviewed v1.

240 unique ACTIVE parents, 4,945 unique variants; EXACT first/final parent counts and parent update/publication/count manifest equal. 278 trace pages plus two identity calls = 280 calls; all 242 connections close and reconcile.

4,923 exact source IDs after excluding all and only 22 availableForSale=false variants; zero out_of_stock rows. Every parent is Online Store and U.S.-published; no legal current-schema per-variant publication field was assumed.
All rows match exact source USD decimal price, variant URL, Shopify image, shared parent group ID and explicit brand/MPN/GTIN provenance. Strict TSV shape and title/description bounds pass.
V2 preserves nine numerically grounded 13+ adult values while the synthetic Girl 3T conflicting-parent-adult case is omitted. Missing source fields remain blank; no invented demographics claimed.

125 emitted GTINs match source and independently pass length/checksum; no synthesized brand or MPN. Public TSV pattern scan found no recognized Shopify token/private-key/Bearer or supplier-domain patterns.

Every row excludes Shopping_ads. Exact native source must be Free listings only. Optional return_policy_label column is absent; 720 exception rows/48 parents remain diagnostic only. This does not certify native returns setup or impose an unsupported upload hold.

Bundled Node --test exit 0: 24 named tests plus fixture-module load, 25 reported passes and zero failures. Meaningful pagination, mutation, replacement, malformed-row, stale-data, CAS and lifecycle cases inspected.
9/9 independent checks: direct stream identity/no buffering, HEAD never reads body, POST/disabled market rejected, changed ETag/wrong currency/stale/absent pointer rejected, no scheduler export.

Frozen wrangler main=host.js, no Cron, no Admin secret binding, two R2 reads per request and no source/write handler. Scheduled full collection is not approved by this verdict; actual Cloudflare CPU performance is not measured here.

Reviewed only, not executed: frozen hash guard, fixed account/new bucket, both target absence checks, immutable object first, remote full SHA256/bytes/ETag equality before current.json, then pointer equality readback. Valid for new empty single-writer bucket; not a general concurrent-update protocol. Initial weak transport-ETag stop is preserved, and hash-bound finalize script passes narrow preflight: full frozen/existing-body SHA256+MD5+bytes rechecked, no immutable PUT, absent pointer only, readback equality. Raw R2 ETag stays EXPECTED until the serving host passes its binding check.

Reviewer writes only code-review.md/json; no native/API/credential/deployment/account/source mutation. Root owns live readbacks, Merchant source receipt, actual rendering, native return completion, automatic refresh and later markets.

transport_etag_amendment.basis: Root reports initial immutable PUT and matching body but weak HTTP transport ETag caused safe stop before pointer. Reviewed bounded resume verifies full existing body SHA256, MD5 and bytes and frozen files, requires pointer absent, writes only pointer and verifies equality. It never overwrites the immutable object.
transport_etag_amendment.gate: Do not equate weak HTTP transport ETag or decoded-body MD5 with a raw R2 binding readback. Unchanged host must serve successfully (binding ETag comparison) and root must verify exact public body before Merchant submission.
